name: Château Lanessan 2019
tasting_note: Cherries, a little pencil shaving, tannins that behave themselves. Open with roast chicken.

name: Domaine Vacheron Sancerre 2023
tasting_note: Lean, salty, better cold than you'd expect. Oysters, or nothing.

name: Produttori del Barbaresco 2020
tasting_note: Roses, tar, and a grip that needs an hour in the decanter. Braised anything.

name: Ridge Lytton Springs 2021
tasting_note: Blackberry, black pepper, and more restraint than Zinfandel usually shows. Grilled lamb.
